takes.title: Give Hand Signals after a Standing Pause
takes.actionDescription: The performer stands with arms down, then alternates crossed forearms, small forward signals and hand lifts near the face. They finish with both forearms in front.

takes.title: Act Out a Teapot Rhyme with a Low Pouring Motion
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises one hand with the other at the waist, repeats the shape with bent knees, and leans far to the side with one arm low. They straighten to finish.

takes.title: Gesture from Repeated Bent-Knee Side Leans
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens in a low side lean, alternates crossing the arms and reaching to the sides, and finishes slightly crouched with one arm extended.

takes.title: Act Out a Rhyme with Low Bends and Open Arms
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with arms gathered and knees bent, alternates short hand gestures and low bends, and finishes folded forward with the arms apart.

takes.title: Give Standing Signals with a Wide Arm Opening
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates a single raised forearm with both arms open at chest height, then lowers the arms and holds an upright staggered stance.

takes.title: Act Out a Teapot Rhyme with Side Reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer keeps one hand near the hip while moving the other from a low side reach to a raised forearm. A forward side bend leads back to standing.

takes.title: Act Out a Rhyme with Alternating Dips and Hand Lifts
takes.actionDescription: The performer begins with a side lean, alternates small crouches and face-level gestures with upright resets, and lowers both arms to finish.

takes.title: Alternate Wide Arm Sweeps and Overhead Gestures
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens hands-on-hips, moves through long passages of side reaches and raised arms with pauses between them, and finishes upright with arms down.

takes.title: Gesture Forward and Turn through Shallow Crouches
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates compact forward gestures with sideways turns, knee bends, and a wider arm opening. The hands draw in and the body straightens near the finish.

takes.title: Mime a Prairie Dog with Short Dips
takes.actionDescription: The performer draws both hands near the face and repeatedly bends and straightens the knees. The take ends facing sideways with the forearms raised.

takes.title: Mime a Whale with Repeated Side Reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer leans and swings the arms out sideways, returns upright between reaches, and ends with one arm extended diagonally down.

takes.title: Mime a Bear with High Reaches and Low Dips
takes.actionDescription: The performer lifts an arm high, lowers into repeated bent-knee dips, and resumes high gestures before folding forward to finish.

takes.title: Mime a Dog with Low Arm Positions
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates shallow bends and upright resets with the arms hanging low in front. The sequence ends with knees still bent.

takes.title: Mime a Cat with Soft Knees and Low Hand Sweeps
takes.actionDescription: The performer begins leaning, sweeps one hand low, and repeats small shifts and bends with the forearms held near the torso. They finish slightly folded forward.

takes.title: Mime an Elephant with a Hanging Arm and Forward Folds
takes.actionDescription: The performer bends forward repeatedly with one arm hanging, briefly reaches upward, then returns to a low folded stance.

takes.title: Mime a Dinosaur with Short Forearm Motions
takes.actionDescription: The performer keeps the elbows bent and forearms forward, makes several small leans and a deeper fold, then comes back upright with hands still in front.

takes.title: Mime a Mouse with Hands Gathered and Repeated Bows
takes.actionDescription: The performer begins upright with hands together, repeatedly folds forward, and ends bent at the waist with the hands drawn toward the chest.

takes.title: Mime a Chicken with Elbows Out and Springy Knees
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeatedly flexes the knees with elbows held wide, shifts between the feet, and folds forward at the end.

takes.title: Mime a Snake with a Forward Bend and Raised Arms
takes.actionDescription: The performer begins folded forward with hands gathered, straightens, then sweeps the arms outward and raises them overhead. Both arms remain bent and lifted at the end.

takes.title: Mime a Monkey with Raised Hands and Side Leans
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts bent, raises one or both hands near the head, and alternates torso dips with arms opening. They finish upright with one hand out.
